title: discovery_setting
description: The Discovery settings: one record for the whole product, edited in the Console (see DISCOVERY_GUIDE.md and DISCOVERY_SETTING_GUIDE.md). The run mode (off, dry_run, live) is not here: it comes from the environment with the secrets, so a mistake in the Console can never turn live AI calls on. Rules the schema cannot express: exactly one record exists (settings_key is always default); default_spend_cap_cents is not above max_spend_cap_cents; results_per_step is not above max_results_per_run; a run's own cap and result limit cannot exceed the maximums here; fields marked readOnly are set by the server only.
x_retention: Kept. The record is replaced in place; each run keeps the cap and limits it used. (A written policy only.)

settings_key.description: Always default. It makes the one-record rule checkable, because ids are UUIDs. Required.

default_model_id.description: The model the Run tab selects first. Optional; absent means the first active model.

default_spend_cap_cents.description: The spend cap the Run tab starts with, in whole US cents. Required.

max_spend_cap_cents.description: The most any single run may be allowed to spend, in whole US cents. The Run tab cannot go above it. Required.

max_results_per_run.description: The most candidates any single run may return. Required.

results_per_step.description: How many candidates one AI call is asked for. Small steps keep each call quick and let the spend cap stop a run between calls. Required.

id.description: UUID v4, set by the server; also the Firestore document id.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the record was written under (currently 1). Set by the server.

created_at.description: When the record was created (UTC). Set by the server.

created_by.description: Who created it, as an actor string. Set by the server.

updated_at.description: When the record last changed (UTC). Set by the server.

updated_by.description: Who last changed it. Set by the server.

source.description: Where the record came from: dashboard or import. Set by the server.

deleted_at.description: When the record was soft deleted (UTC); absent while live. Set by the server.

deleted_by.description: Who soft deleted it. Set by the server.
